title: WUJM MCS
body:
[WUJM MCS]

版本Java1.21.11 | 核心Fabric（支持生电）

纯粹·友好·安全 —— 诚邀素质玩家加入！

我们秉承“少而精”的理念，致力于打造一个纯净、稳定、温暖的原版生存社区。在这里，没有纷扰的复杂插件，只有最纯粹的协作与创造。

✨ 服务器核心特色

· 双端互通：支持 Java 1.21.11 与 基岩版（Bedrock） 跨平台同服游玩。
· 内置语音：集成 SimpleVoiceChat（简易语音聊天），沟通更便捷，协作更顺畅。
· 纯净原版：保留 Minecraft 原汁原味的生存体验，注重游戏本质乐趣。
· 安全环境：实行 白名单审核机制，严格筛选玩家，守护社区秩序。

🎉 欢迎这样的你

无论你是热爱红石机械的工程师，还是钟情于建筑的艺术家，亦或是喜欢探索冒险的独行侠——只要遵守规则、尊重他人，“少而精”大家庭都期待与你相遇！

📝 加入方式

请加入 QQ群：1033138189，按群内指引提交审核。
discord:https://discord.gg/Wnaesj3fW3 也可以

⚖️ 玩家守则

1. 友善交流：尊重每一位玩家，拒绝任何形式的言语攻击、歧视或骚扰。
2.  爱护环境：不恶意破坏他人建筑，不偷窃他人物品，珍惜公共设施。

在这里，你的每一份热爱都值得被温柔对待。
期待与你一起，在方块世界中书写属于我们的故事。

---

[WUJM MCS]

Version Java 1.21.11 | Core: Fabric (Supports Cross-Platform)

Pure · Friendly · Safe — We sincerely invite quality players to join!

We adhere to the philosophy of “Less is More” and are committed to creating a clean, stable, and warm vanilla survival community. Here, there are no complicated plugins—just pure collaboration and creation.

✨ Server Features
	•	Cross-Platform Support: Java 1.21.11 and Bedrock Edition players can play together on the same server.
	•	Built-in Voice Chat: Integrated SimpleVoiceChat for easier communication and smoother collaboration.
	•	Pure Vanilla: Retaining the true survival experience of Minecraft, focusing on the fundamental joy of the game.
	•	Safe Environment: A whitelist review system to carefully select players and maintain community order.

🎉 We Welcome Players Like You

Whether you’re a redstone engineer, a passionate builder, or a lone adventurer— as long as you follow the rules and respect others, the “Less is More” family looks forward to meeting you!

📝 How to Join

Please join the QQ group: 1033138189, and follow the instructions within the group to submit your application for review.
If you don't have QQ you can join our discord server https://discord.gg/Wnaesj3fW3 and contact administrator to get a membership.

⚖️ Player Code of Conduct
	1.	Friendly Communication: Respect every player and reject any form of verbal attacks, discrimination, or harassment.
	2.	Respect the Environment: Do not maliciously destroy other players’ builds, steal their items, or damage public facilities.

Here, your passion will always be treated with kindness. We look forward to writing our own stories in the block world together with you.
